briefdescription.para: ONNX proto message classes — the lightweight, protobuf-free ONNX schema.

detaileddescription.para: Every class in this file is generated from the macros defined in stream_class.h (BEGIN_PROTO / END_PROTO / FIELD* / SERIALIZATION_METHOD). Each class inherits from ONNX_LIGHT_NAMESPACE::Message and provides parse/serialize methods as well as typed field accessors following the pattern described in the API documentation.
